critical_code_review_comments: server.py contract_upload_pdf: only extension-based check (.pdf) — no MIME cross-validation. A jpg renamed to .pdf would pass. For prod, also check file magic bytes (e.g. starts with %PDF-).

server.py _contract_effective_status: 'expiring_soon' check uses `0 <= days_left <= 30`, but the description says '1-30 days'. With this code, a contract ending today (days_left=0) is 'expiring_soon' while 'expired' branch already catches end < today. This is correct (today-ending = expiring_soon, yesterday-ending = expired), but worth a code comment to avoid future regressions.

server.py contract_extend: does NOT check that the contract is currently terminated/expired before extending — admin can keep pushing end_date forward on already-active contracts. This is fine product-wise, but the path also resets terminated_at/terminated_reason to None even if the contract was never terminated. Harmless but noisy in audit log.

server.py admin_blacklist_label: missing label check before update_one — if label not found, response still returns {ok:true} with 0 modifications. Add label existence check (already done — line 2599-2601), good. But admin_unblacklist_label (line 2611) has NO existence check, so calling with a bad id returns 200 with 0 modifications.
models.py BlacklistIn / ContractTerminateIn use `reason: str = Field(min_length=3)` — fine, but the frontend test-id 'admin-label-blacklist-reason' is verified to require ≥3 chars (matches). OK.

NotificationBell polls every 30s — for users with many notifications this re-fetches limit=20 each poll. Consider exposing a lightweight `/api/notifications/unread-count` endpoint to avoid sending 20 items every 30s per online user.
notify_many uses `insert_many` without indexes — recommend ensuring an index on notifications.user_id + read_at for the unread_count count_documents call performed every poll.
